summary: AutonomyEngine.run_cycle pauses on durable critical/exhausted budget or would_pause_next_cycle even when enabled=false or risk_tolerance=off, matching PM surface-gate doctrine (#634/#653/#867).
migration_impact: Autonomous cycles may pause under risk=off when spend leaves remaining below per_cycle or pressure is critical/exhausted. Raise token_budget, wait for UTC day rollover, or reset spend to resume.
agent_notes: Do not treat risk=off as permission to run cycles when budget_pressure is critical or would_pause_next_cycle is true. Resolve budget_gate first; mirrors PM #866.
